description.value:
One per weapon; damage is unchanged. Light and Medium: Throwing Handle (no reach; thrown on the Shortbow table), Short (default), Long (4m), Very Long (6m; thrown on the Bow table), Chain (10m; can't be thrown). Heavy and Very Heavy: Short (default), Long (4m), Very Long (6m; Bow table). Long and Very Long handles can't be concealed or go in Popup cyberware; Very Long drops to ROF1 and needs BODY 14+ one-handed.

Cost: 100eb
Fits: All Melee Weapons, individual eligibility by weapon category
